title: Patch: a Buff or a Nerf draws only a change that still does something where the card is: one table of live targets by zone, and an audit of every card
notes: R3888000: a Buff or a Nerf draws only a change that is live where the card is, by one table (SPEC §6.3) of deck, hand, being played (§10.5 step 3, where hidden Nerfs land), field face-up, face-down, Dormant, graveyard and exile, read from one place (effects::tune_live) by every menu row and by hidden Nerfs. On the field Rush and Charge past the Unit's entry turn (unless its own Reborn brings it back sick), Echo, Crater, Equip, Stack, GIGA, Tipsy, Flexible, Cloaked, Tradable and Temporary are no longer drawn; a hidden Nerf never draws the Tribute step 2 paid; a face-down Cloaked card's Cry numbers, stats and R21 keywords are drawn, read as the card it is; in a deck Cloaked and Crater are live as in a hand; a face-down Trap may take Crater; in a graveyard only a card a play may take from there changes (any card may take Flashback) and in exile none; a unit token never takes Flashback. R3888001: Param.cry is now Param.read (cry, combo, castOnDraw, awaken, evolve, handOrDeck, graveyard) with readOn for one face, held to the text by catalog check; the 90 cry marks are renamed and 38 numbers on 27 cards newly marked, which is the 95 cards claimed; the Patch notes diff names the reader.

player.title: Buffs and Nerfs only change what still matters
changes: On the field, a Buff or a Nerf no longer gives or removes Rush or Charge after the turn the Unit arrived.
On the field, a Buff or a Nerf no longer changes Echo, Crater, Cloaked or another keyword that only works as a card is played or from your hand.
On the field, a Buff or a Nerf no longer changes a number only its Combo, Cast on draw or awakening uses, nor one its Evolve uses once it has evolved.
A Buff or a Nerf can now change the Cry numbers of a Cloaked card set face-down, which still has its Cry to come.
Buffs can now give Cloaked to, and take Crater off, cards in your deck, as in your hand.
Hidden Nerfs no longer raise a Tribute you have just paid.
In a graveyard, a Buff or a Nerf only changes a card that can be played from there; any card can still gain Flashback.
Cards in an exile pile are no longer changed by a Buff or a Nerf.
